title: Why Do Rules Exist in Games?
hook: Rules make a game fair and possible.
narration: Rules make a game fair and possible.
This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do Rules Exist in Games.
Without them, nobody knows how to win.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
If a rule is unkind, grown-ups can change it.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Rules make a game fair and possible.
The pictures today are a new shape world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do rules exist in games.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
